description: This file defines a set of classes and functions for automating and testing checkout-related UI interactions in the Notesnook project, including navigating plans, pricing, coupons, and country selection.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: Represents the checkout page model, providing methods to navigate and retrieve plans and pricing.

classes.name: Plan
classes.description: Represents an individual plan element on the checkout page, allowing access to its title and opening the plan details.

classes.name: PricingModel
classes.description: Represents the pricing section within the checkout process, providing methods to wait for elements, get prices, apply coupons, and change country or plan.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to the checkout URL with optional period and coupon parameters.

methods.name: getPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available plans, excluding those starting with 'Education'.

methods.name: getPricing
methods.description: Returns the PricingModel instance after waiting for it to load.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Gets the title text of a plan or pricing section.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a plan to view its pricing details.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Waits for the pricing section to be ready.

methods.name: waitForCoupon
methods.description: Waits for the coupon to be applied and visible.

methods.name: waitForPaddleFrame
methods.description: Waits for the Paddle iframe to load.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Retrieves the list of price items with labels and values.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a coupon code and waits for it to be reflected.

methods.name: changeCountry
methods.description: Changes the country and optionally the postcode, then waits for the update.
